title: App Game_Over surge-win copy branch + game-over meter draw have no automated coverage
detail: app/ has no test files and capture_frame (harness/goldens.odin) draws only world/forecast/meter/banner — never the Game_Over screen. The new copy branch and game-over meter draw run only in manual app play.
recommended_fix: Accept as convention (app HUD is manually verified) or extend capture_frame to render the Game_Over overlay so a golden pins it.

title: parse_demo 'win surge'/'health on' validation error branches untested
detail: No harness test suite exists (no harness/*_test.odin); the new rejection branches (pct > 100, non-'on' health verb) run only if a malformed .dem is authored. Happy path covered by both new demos.
recommended_fix: Add a small parse_demo test table in harness covering bad win surge / bad health / valid pairs, or accept as tooling convention.
